title: The Ratpack
description: An adventure based modpack optimized for Fabric and Multiplayer with friends
body:
The RatPack is my personal modpack that I've been working on for a while now and decided to post it here because I find it quite fun to use and hope you do too.

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

The RatPack focuses on including open adventure like mods to give you things to do without urgent objectives (i.e. [Aether](https://modrinth.com/mod/aether), [Better Nether](https://modrinth.com/mod/betternether), [Ad Astra](https://modrinth.com/mod/ad-astra)), optimization to help run the game as well as it can with these new features, and multiplayer optimization with the inclusion of [e4mc](https://modrinth.com/mod/e4mc) to host worlds from your own PC and Player customization to add some fun to the adventure.

Anyway thank you and enjoy the pack
